pages.title: Location
pages.text: Consult the quest boss guide for this encounter. Use the matching Dynasty dimension portal.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Bring armour, healing and a return portal.

pages.title: Battle
pages.text: Avoid telegraphed attacks and defeat reinforcements. Break the shield before committing.

pages.title: Summoning
pages.text: Place at least four jade blocks in the eight spaces around the Ritual Altar, on its level. Use the matching boss token on the altar. One token is consumed; a nearby living boss prevents duplicates.
